The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the fifteenth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[S15|Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies]], in {{pmin|Australia}} and {{pmin|New Zealand}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 4}}). ==Partial collections== {{incomplete|section|Disc divisions}} Two Rival Destinies Collections were released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in 2013, containing the whole season between them. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. ===Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies - Collection 1=== [[File:BW Rival Destinies Collection 1.png|thumb|Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies - Collection 1]] Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies - Collection 1 was released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on February 3, 2013 and in New Zealand on January 19, 2013. It contains three discs with 25 episodes across them combined. ''[[BW097|Unova's Survival Crisis!]]'' |} ==Season 15 disc set== [[File:BW Season 15.png|thumb|DigiPack cover art]] [[File:BW Season 15 Repack.png|thumb|Slimline cover art]] {{wp|Magna Pacific}} (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) began releasing DigiPack disc sets of each season in 2010. The Season 15 DigiPack disc set was released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on October 2, 2013 and in New Zealand on October 16, 2013. It contains six discs with 49 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE4875. The DigiPack disc set was re-released exclusive to JB Hi-Fi online [https://www.facebook.com/BeyondHomeEntertainment/posts/980903292007738 on July 14, 2016] and in JB Hi-Fi stores [https://www.facebook.com/BeyondHomeEntertainment/posts/1034172803347453 on September 21, 2016] to celebrate the [[Pokémon 20th Anniversary]]. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. This disc set was re-released by Beyond Home Entertainment in a slimline case on April 2, 2014 in Australia with a different cover and the catalogue number BHE5399. ===Contents=== Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself.
